Vendored frontend assets for offline demonstrations:

- Bootstrap 5.3.3 (`bootstrap.min.css`, `bootstrap.bundle.min.js`), [MIT license](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/v5.3.3/LICENSE).
- Chart.js 4.4.8 (`chart.umd.min.js`), [MIT license](https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/blob/v4.4.8/LICENSE.md).

Files were downloaded from the pinned jsDelivr package paths shown in the project history. Review upstream licenses and update these files together when upgrading.
